items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: the job I played Knox and Trotta was with Harold on, the other job at the Marriott. And I was like, I do a lot of work with them.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, they'll have different guys from the Tuxedo. They use Knox and Trotta.
Yeah, because the job I played Knox and Trotta was with Harold on, the other job at the Marriott. And I was like, I do a lot of work with them. They get me working with them too.
Getting all the work through that time. It turns out, huh?
